entryRule: exact frozen entrySession; stock and SPY entry bars must exist on that exact XNYS session
exitRule: entry session index + horizon on the XNYS/SPY session calendar; no nearest/later substitution
benchmark: SPY exact same entry open and exit close
maeRule: compute only when every exact stock session in the entry-to-exit path is present and regular; otherwise MAE is missing with explicit quality reason
coverageBeforePerformanceRule: Compute event-specific identity/entry/SPY coverage and tier before forward returns. If below Tier C, stop and do not compute development returns.
missingOutcomeRule: never impute zero and never silently drop; report exact attrition reason
continuityTreatment: First B3 run is canonical/descriptive on frozen adjusted market bars with explicit missing/delisted attrition. Security-continuity correction, if required, is a separate performance-blind gate before formal inference.
